set4_cond_inEtherVeil_desc: When the equipper is within any <ct color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</ct>, their CRIT Rate increases by 10%. After leaving the <ct color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</ct>, this buff remains for 15s.
set4_cond_activateExtendVeil_desc: If the equipper is an <ct color=#FFFFFF>Attack</ct> character, activating an <ct color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</ct> or extending an <ct color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</ct>'s duration increases their CRIT Rate by 10% and ATK by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
